Greater New Orleans human-trafficking data

NewOrl.Rd

Capture-history data for identified victims of human trafficking in Greater New Orleans. The data comprise eight confidentially labelled lists, denoted A to H. Further details are given by Bales, Murphy and Silverman (2020).

Usage

NewOrl

Format

A data frame with 19 rows and 9 columns. Columns A to H are binary indicators of inclusion in the eight lists. Column n gives the number of cases having each observed capture history.

References

Bales, K., Murphy, L. and Silverman, B. W. (2020). How many trafficked people are there in Greater New Orleans? Journal of Human Trafficking, 6(4), 375–384. doi:10.1080/23322705.2019.1634936 .
